=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1527-1544 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: An indented positive lead-in or prose line after a negative list remains suppressed by `next if /^\s{2,}\S/;`, so template-owned paths in the resumed section can escape scanning.
  WHY: The implementation contradicts the comment that any other non-blank line ends suppression; reviewers agree this edge case is uncovered, with confidence disagreement noted by mistralai_mistral-small-2603 at 3 for the comment mismatch.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1544 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The continuation-line suppression pattern requires at least 2 spaces of indentation, so a continuation line indented with exactly 1 space resets `$neg` and exposes subsequent negative-list items to edit-target scanning.
  WHY: A single-space wrapped continuation can prematurely exit suppression and recreate the false-positive failure the fix is intended to prevent.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1539-1540 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The negative lead-in regex no longer accepts bullet-prefixed negative lines.
  WHY: A line such as "- No changes to `scripts/render_prompt.sh`." can be scanned as an edit target and cause a false rejection, although a broader suppression rule could reintroduce sibling-target smuggling.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2219 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The `\<lacks?\>` alternative inside `BLOCKED_REAL_OBSTACLE_REGEX` is missing its closing `\>` word boundary.
  WHY: With GNU grep -E, `\<lacks?` matches any word beginning with "lack"/"lacks", including "lacking", and can veto a genuine success-no-op verdict; this finding is disputed by minimax_minimax-m3, which reports the live pattern has both word boundaries.
- changelog.d/plan-implement-noop-false-failures.md:line 1 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The fragment filename lacks the required numeric issue-or-PR prefix mandated by CLAUDE.md §20.B.
  WHY: Without the numeric prefix, concurrent PRs can collide on the same fragment path and the required traceability mechanism is broken.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
